versions.changelog: Stabilize project-scoped env loading and improve the article illustration workflow.
Align runtime config loading and safer image batch defaults.

Anime Image Generator Skill v0.5.0 introduces a structured, agent-guided workflow for secure, robust anime-style image generation.

- Enforces strict anime-style output: always uses "anime style, cel shaded, highly detailed, beautiful lighting".
- Implements a first-use readiness gate, checking dependencies and API key before any generation.
- Automates local default to Nano Banana 2 (GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_IMAGE); guides users on changing models.
- Security-focused: API keys handled as secrets and can be set up interactively by the agent.
- Enhances reliability with detailed backend contract validation and robust error handling.
- Streamlines onboarding and workflow with agent-led model discovery, prompt building, and dependency management.
